predicates.reason: Limit base roll to maintain lateral stability.
Limit base pitch to avoid tipping forward or backward.
Maintain feasible and stable base height above ground.
Limit foot slippage to ensure reliable contact forces.
Ensure sufficient foot clearance during swing to avoid collisions.

safety_specification.formula: G_[0,H](Roll <= roll_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Pitch <= pitch_max) ∧ G_[0,H](base_height_min <= Base_height <= base_height_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Slip <= slip_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Swing_clearance >= swing_clearance_min)

predicates.reason: Track commanded velocity within acceptable error.
Walking typically maintains at least three feet on the ground for static stability.
Walking should not include aerial phases; enforce near-zero flight time.
Walking uses high duty factor (>0.5) per leg.

gait_specification.formula: G_[0,H](P_3plus >= p_3plus_min) ∧ G_[0,H](P_flight <= p_flight_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Duty_factor >= duty_factor_min_walk)

combined_symbolic_stl.formula: G_[0,H](Roll <= roll_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Pitch <= pitch_max) ∧ G_[0,H](base_height_min <= Base_height <= base_height_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Slip <= slip_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Swing_clearance >= swing_clearance_min) ∧ G_[0,H](Velocity_tracking_error <= vel_err_max) ∧ G_[0,H](P_3plus >= p_3plus_min) ∧ G_[0,H](P_flight <= p_flight_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Duty_factor >= duty_factor_min_walk)
parameter_fitting_notes: p_3plus_min: fit as average P_3plus over expert walking trajectories.
p_flight_max: set slightly above observed noise floor in expert data (e.g., 0.01).
duty_factor_min_walk: estimate from mean duty factor of individual legs in expert walk data.
All safety and tracking bounds can be fit as max/min observed values plus small margins.

predicates.reason: Trot relies on alternating diagonal two-foot support phases.
Trot spends most time with exactly two feet in contact.
Diagonal legs should land and lift synchronously in trot.
Trot may have brief flight phases but should remain mostly grounded.

gait_specification.formula: G_[0,H](P_diag2 >= p_diag2_min) ∧ G_[0,H](P_2contact >= p_2contact_min) ∧ G_[0,H](Diagonal_pair_sync_error <= diag_sync_err_max) ∧ G_[0,H](P_flight <= p_flight_trot_max)

combined_symbolic_stl.formula: G_[0,H](Roll <= roll_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Pitch <= pitch_max) ∧ G_[0,H](base_height_min <= Base_height <= base_height_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Slip <= slip_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Swing_clearance >= swing_clearance_min) ∧ G_[0,H](Velocity_tracking_error <= vel_err_max) ∧ G_[0,H](P_diag2 >= p_diag2_min) ∧ G_[0,H](P_2contact >= p_2contact_min) ∧ G_[0,H](Diagonal_pair_sync_error <= diag_sync_err_max) ∧ G_[0,H](P_flight <= p_flight_trot_max)
parameter_fitting_notes: p_diag2_min and p_2contact_min: fit from empirical fractions in expert trot data.
diag_sync_err_max: compute as max observed diagonal sync error in successful trots.
p_flight_trot_max: set based on maximum observed flight fraction in expert trot (typically <0.2).

predicates.reason: Bounding involves aerial phases that can amplify pitch instability; tighter pitch bound may be needed.
Bounding alternates between front-pair and hind-pair stance.
Bounding includes substantial aerial phases; require minimum flight fraction.

predicates.symbolic_form: Front_hind_phase_error ≈ π (mod 2π), encoded via bounded deviation
predicates.reason: Bounding requires anti-phase coordination between front and hind pairs.
Bounding should avoid diagonal support patterns typical of trot.

gait_specification.formula: G_[0,H]((P_front_pair + P_hind_pair) >= p_pair_support_min) ∧ G_[0,H](P_flight >= p_flight_min_bound) ∧ G_[0,H](phase_offset_min <= Front_hind_phase_error <= phase_offset_max) ∧ G_[0,H](P_diag2 <= p_diag2_bound_max)

combined_symbolic_stl.formula: G_[0,H](Roll <= roll_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Pitch <= pitch_max) ∧ G_[0,H](base_height_min <= Base_height <= base_height_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Slip <= slip_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Swing_clearance >= swing_clearance_min) ∧ G_[0,H](Velocity_tracking_error <= vel_err_max) ∧ G_[0,H](Pitch <= pitch_max_bound) ∧ G_[0,H]((P_front_pair + P_hind_pair) >= p_pair_support_min) ∧ G_[0,H](P_flight >= p_flight_min_bound) ∧ G_[0,H](phase_offset_min <= Front_hind_phase_error <= phase_offset_max) ∧ G_[0,H](P_diag2 <= p_diag2_bound_max)
parameter_fitting_notes: p_pair_support_min: sum of mean P_front_pair and P_hind_pair from expert bounding data.
p_flight_min_bound: fit as average P_flight in successful bounds (typically >0.2).
phase_offset_min/max: center around π with tolerance fitted from phase error distribution.
p_diag2_bound_max: set below typical trot values (e.g., <0.1) based on expert data.
pitch_max_bound: may be stricter than general pitch_max; fit from max pitch during flight in expert bounds.

warnings: Phase error predicate assumes a well-defined phase signal; if phase is noisy or undefined during long flight, robustness may degrade.
The symbolic form 'Front_hind_phase_error ≈ π' is approximated by a bounded interval; this assumes phase is normalized to [0, 2π] or [-π, π].

global_warnings: All horizons H are symbolic and should be chosen as integer multiples of the dominant gait period to capture full cycles.
Smooth approximations of STL robustness (e.g., using log-sum-exp) will be needed for differentiable rewards in PPO.
Some signals like 'Duty_factor' and 'Front_hind_phase_error' require cycle detection or event-based processing; their computation must be compatible with online evaluation over [t-H, t].
Parameter fitting assumes availability of segmented, labeled expert trajectories for each gait mode.
